name: Being Successful
overview: Scripture teaches that true success comes from relying on the LORD, who gives the power to gain wealth and blesses obedience to His commands (Deuteronomy 8:18; Joshua 1:7). Walking away from ungodly counsel and committing our works to God leads to established thoughts and prosperous outcomes (Psalms 1:1; Proverbs 16:3). God’s plans for His people are for peace and a hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11), and through Christ’s strength, believers can accomplish all things (Philippians 4:13).
